name: Texas Eastern TIME Expansion (Incremental Market Area Expansion)

values.OtherEnglishNames: TETCO TIME Expansion (Incremental Market Area Expansion)

researcher_notes: Source: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, August 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 267. EIA says: operator Texas Eastern Transmission, Expansion, Completed 2002-12, in service 2002, states WV,NJ, cost 75.23 million USD, 36 mi, +100 MMcf/d incremental capacity, 36 in, interstate, FERC docket CP02-32. Not an existing GEM row: roster has P0262 (main line), P0260/P5832 (TEAM), P2008 (TEMAX), none named TIME or sized 36 mi in 2002. Passes length rule (36 mi = 57.9 km, over 25 km), sponsor, endpoints and a completed project. Single origin only (EIA). A FERC order or filing for CP02-32 was not read because the web search tool hit its session limit; the pairing is still owed. EIA lists only the end states (WV, NJ), so the actual loop locations (likely Pennsylvania and New Jersey) are unconfirmed and the state fields should be checked against the FERC order. Segment name and Owner spelling are drafted; Owner reuses the gazetteer entity 'Texas Eastern Transmission LP'. No route researched. Tier medium: one validated reference, single origin.
